description: Establish and record the empirical Phase 2 baseline. Confirm the whole workspace is green before touching runtime hooks, and write down the true starting state of each binding crate (what hook code exists, whether it builds, what actually records events) so later features build on verified facts rather than the inaccurate *_COMPLETE.md docs.
steps: From repo root run `cargo build --release` and confirm it finishes clean.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` and confirm zero warnings.
Run `cargo test` and confirm all workspace tests pass.
Rebuild the Python module: `cd xplainit-python && source ../.venv/bin/activate && maturin develop --release`.

Run the Python integration suites and record pass counts: `python test_automatic_tracing.py` (expect 3/3), `python xplainit-python/test_frame_filter.py` (expect 11/11), `python xplainit-python/test_decorators.py` (expect pass).

Verify toolchain availability and record versions: `gcc --version`, `clang --version`, `javac -version`, `go version`, `python3 --version`, `cargo --version`; and confirm `node`/`npm` are absent (only `bun` present).

Write a concise BASELINE section into the feature `findings` field: per-crate (python/node/c/java/go) note whether the native artifact builds and whether any on_function_enter/exit/exception recording entry point already exists, plus the toolchain matrix.
acceptance_criteria: cargo build --release, cargo clippy -D warnings, and cargo test all pass from a clean state.
python test_automatic_tracing.py reports 3/3; xplainit-python/test_frame_filter.py reports 11/11; test_decorators.py passes.
findings field records the verified per-crate baseline and the toolchain matrix (including node/npm absence).
verification: source .venv/bin/activate && python test_automatic_tracing.py && python xplainit-python/test_frame_filter.py && python xplainit-python/test_decorators.py
findings:
PHASE 2 BASELINE (verified from a clean state on branch phase2-runtime-hooks; commit d5138fc as parent).

WORKSPACE GREEN CHECKS (all PASS):
- cargo build --release: clean, finished in ~10s, no warnings.
- cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings: clean, exit 0, zero warnings.
- cargo test: ALL PASS. Per-crate results: xplainit-c 5 passed; xplainit-core 82 passed; core integration_tests 9 passed; xplainit-java 1 passed (test_jni_module_compiles); xplainit-node 1 passed (test_module_compiles); xplainit-python 6 passed; core doc-test 1 passed. 0 failed across the workspace.
- Native artifacts produced by cargo build --release in target/release/: libxplainit_c.a, libxplainit_c.so, libxplainit_java.so, libxplainit_node.so, libxplainit_python.so. Prebuilt xplainit-node/index.node present.

PYTHON MODULE + INTEGRATION SUITES (all PASS):
- maturin develop --release from inside xplainit-python (venv Python 3.9, abi3-py3.8): built and installed editable package 'xplainit' (import name = xplainit, NOT xplainit_python).
- python test_automatic_tracing.py: 3/3 (100%) PASS.
- python xplainit-python/test_frame_filter.py: 11/11 PASS.
- python xplainit-python/test_decorators.py: PASS (@trace, @trace_class, @profile, @trace_recursive, error handling all working; 1 exception event captured in error test).

TOOLCHAIN MATRIX (verified in sandbox):
- gcc: 11.5.0 (Red Hat 11.5.0-5)
- clang: 15.0.7 (AWS amzn2023)
- javac: 25.0.2 / java (OpenJDK): 25.0.2
- go: 1.25.1 linux/amd64
- python3: 3.9.25 (venv gives maturin 1.15.0)
- cargo: 1.92.0
- node: ABSENT (command not found)
- npm: ABSENT (command not found)
- bun: 1.2.14 present (bun is NOT node; cannot drive the Neon npm build pipeline). => Node end-to-end runtime tracing (Task 2.2) CANNOT be fully verified in this sandbox.

PER-CRATE HOOK BASELINE (does a recording entry point for on_function_enter/exit/exception already exist?):
- PYTHON (xplainit-python): FULLY WIRED. PyO3 module exports on_function_enter/on_function_exit/on_exception (+ on_line_execute); python/tracer.py AutoTracer uses sys.settrace and calls these; backend parses values via tracer::parse_python_value and calls event_store().record(). Records REAL events end to end (confirmed by the 3 integration suites). No work needed here for hook recording.
- NODE (xplainit-node): Rust Neon addon (src/lib.rs) EXPORTS onFunctionEnter/onFunctionExit/onException; each builds an ExecutionEvent and calls rt.event_store().record(...). The recording entry points EXIST at the Rust layer and libxplainit_node.so builds via cargo. JS tracers (javascript/tracer.js etc.) and index.node prebuilt exist. BUT: no node/npm in sandbox, so the standard Neon npm build + full JS->native round-trip CANNOT be verified here.
- C (xplainit-c): NO recording entry points yet. src/lib.rs #[no_mangle] extern "C" functions are only: xplainit_create, xplainit_free, xplainit_enable, xplainit_disable, xplainit_is_enabled, xplainit_get_events, xplainit_clear_events, xplainit_get_statistics, xplainit_free_string, xplainit_version. The cbindgen-generated include/xplainit-c.h has NO function_enter/exit/exception/record symbols. Adding on_function_enter/exit/exception FFI is required (Task 2.3).
- JAVA (xplainit-java): NO recording natives yet. src/lib.rs JNI natives are only: nativeCreate, nativeFree, nativeEnable, nativeDisable, nativeIsEnabled, nativeGetEvents, nativeClearEvents, nativeGetStatistics. No method-entry/exit/exception natives. Adding them + Java-side agent/hook is required (Task 2.4).
- GO (xplainit-go): NO recording path. xplainit.go is a CGO wrapper that only calls the existing C FFI (create/free/enable/disable/is_enabled/get_events/clear_events/get_statistics/version). Go recording depends on the C FFI recording entry points being added first (Task 2.5 depends on 2.3).

SUMMARY: Baseline is fully green. Python records real events; Node has Rust-side recording exports but is unverifiable end-to-end without node/npm; C, Java, and Go have NO recording entry points and are the core targets for Phase 2 tasks 2.3-2.5 (Go blocked on C).
